name: physics-constrained-numerical-validation
intent: Validate numerical behavior against physical constraints and convergence evidence while keeping model, discretization, and real-world claims separate.
successCondition: Stop when units, invariants, limiting cases, convergence, stability, and proof limits are recorded with a pass or failure.
inputs: numerical method mesh timestep and tolerances
analytic limiting or trusted reference cases
outputs: convergence residual invariant and limitation evidence
operations: check dimensional consistency and sign conventions
test conservation bounds and limiting cases
measure mesh timestep and solver convergence
separate discretization model and measurement uncertainty
preconditions: units equations boundary conditions and tolerances are explicit
at least one independent physical or analytic reference exists
positiveTriggers: Validate a numerical simulation against physical invariants and limits.
Check units convergence stability and reference cases before interpretation.
negativeTriggers: Claim hardware performance from simulation alone.
Run a model whose units boundary conditions or solver tolerances are undefined.
failureModes: stop interpretation when conservation or convergence fails
report model-form uncertainty instead of tuning it away
exclusions: does not turn numerical stability into physical truth
terminationConditions: Stop when units, invariants, limiting cases, convergence, stability, and proof limits are recorded with a pass or failure.

measurableImprovement.baseline: the current eternities-athena route without this exact operational mechanism
measurableImprovement.threshold: all critical cases pass with exact evidence and no authority or effect regression
